notes:
0.13.0.0
- Campaign mode: city, forest and compound in a row, 10 missions per map, then a boss, then the map's finale. Choose Campaign at the mission setup terminal.
- Three bosses, Campaign only: the Butcher (city), the Hollow (forest) and the Warden (compound), whose blast tears down the compound's interior.
- New missions, 23 in all, and Basic and Complex are one category, Objectives. Supplies are a real item now: gather them, then carry them to the delivery zone.
- New zombies: the Berserker and the Nest.
- Proximity voice chat: push-to-talk (T) or open mic, Esc > Options > Voice & music.
- A music player for your own songs: put MP3 files in Documents\ZAU\Music and press L.
- Loot: items you already found get rarer for the rest of the run; fewer defibrillators.
- Maimed on a zombie hit is now 1 in 25 (the Hunter still always maims).
- The in-run Skills window shows locked, available, learned and maxed skills in clearly different colours.
